label: The alternating remainder
subgoals: For an alternating series the remainder is bounded by the next term.
The bound is tight enough for numerical estimates.

visual.title: The next term bounds the error
visual.caption: The alternating terms change sign, so the partial sums overshoot and undershoot the limit. The gap is never larger than the next term.

predict.question: For an alternating series, the remainder after N terms is bounded by:
predict.explain: The alternating remainder is at most the first omitted term in absolute value, so the partial sum is within one term of ln 2 here.

label: The integral remainder
subgoals: The integral test gives upper and lower bounds for a sum.
The remainder lies between two adjacent integrals.

label: Choosing enough terms
subgoals: Use the remainder bound to solve for the number of terms.
